integrity: The infinite conclusion is proved analytically. The embedded computation only checks the finite reciprocal-series normalization and the structural characterization through a bounded range; it is not used to infer the asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the 3 modulo 8 component of the reciprocal set and does not settle the conjectured density 1/32 of the full reciprocal set. It proves a first-order asymptotic without an explicit error term and relies on the published structural characterization plus standard prime-distribution estimates.
title: An exact asymptotic for the 3-mod-8 reciprocal divisor-sum class
